page.layout: One column of verse, full width: stanzas 13 to 21 of the preceding psalm, then a division heading across the full width, then stanzas 1 to 3 of Psalm CXLVI, the first with a large initial L. Running head at top left-centre, page number top right. No margin notes, no catchword or signature.

main_text.l: 13. Regnum illustre tuū per secula cuncta manebit,
14. Nam Deus invalidos firmat, lapsosque reponit, Praecipitat tumidos.
15. Tu tempestinam te suscipientibus escam Porrigere es solitus.
16. Effuso gremio manibusque animantia laxis Connenienter alis.[?]
18. Ipse equidem presto famulis orantibus astas, Sit modo firma fides.
21. Denique linguamea, ac animata cuncta, Tonāte
I. CONstat x. Heb. vers. totidem Latinis.
2. Non laudabo alium dum sanguis bulliet iste,
3. Fidere principib. fragile est, variabilis aula est,

page.notes: Verse 21 "Denique": the printed form is abbreviated, read as Denique. Verse 21 "linguamea" is printed without a space; kept as printed. Verse 16 "Connenienter" is doubtful: the letters may be Convenienter. Psalm 146, verse 1 "existētē:mēs" is not clear and is marked [?]. Small stray mark ("/") to the right of verse 15: printer's or ink mark, not text. Ligature ć in "cuncta" and "perfecte" read as ct and c. Long s throughout normalised to s; the heading hyphen "CON-stat" is joined as CONstat.
